title: Clone not derived on CredentialStore
description: Clone is intentionally not derived on CredentialStore. The comment explains why: accidental copies waste memory (bcrypt hashes + dummy hash) and would complicate future zeroize-on-drop work. The sharing pattern (Arc<CredentialStore>) is the right approach for a type that is constructed once and used across many sessions. A future contributor might add #[derive(Clone)] without reading the comment. The comment is present and should be preserved.
